name: HL7/fhir
what_it_is: The authoritative source repository for the HL7 FHIR specification, used by core editors to build and publish the official FHIR standard. It is a specification publisher, not a runtime implementation.
constraints: Minimum 16 GB RAM required to build locally
Changes must go through HL7 Jira approval; direct PRs not intended
-web and -noarchive flags restricted to core editors
notable_absences: No runtime server or API endpoints
